```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(plotly)
```

## Dengue Fever

```{r}
dengue <- readRDS("../data/data_dengue.rds")
```

### Trends

```{r}
weekly_cases <- dengue %>%
  mutate(
    week_start = floor_date(date_report, unit = "week", week_start = 1),
    week = isoweek(week_start),
    year = isoyear(week_start),
    week = ifelse(week == 53, 52, week)
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, week) %>%
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop")

trends <- weekly_cases %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2023)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    cdc = mean(cases) + 2 * sd(cases),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
weekly_cases <- weekly_cases %>%
  left_join(trends, by = "week")

weekly_cases <- weekly_cases %>%
  filter(!year %in% c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025))
```

```{r}
weekly_cases$yw <- paste0(weekly_cases$year, weekly_cases$week)
weekly_cases <- weekly_cases %>% 
  mutate(outbreak = ifelse(cases >= cdc, 1, 0))

stsObj <- with(weekly_cases, sts(observed = cases,
                       state = outbreak,
                       start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 52)
)
disProgObj <- sts2disProg(stsObj)

## Farrington algorithms
control <- list(b = 5, w = 1, range = 261:312, reweight = T, verbose = F)
farrington <- algo.farrington(disProgObj, control = control)
f_up <- farrington$upperbound 

## CUSUM algorithms
control <- list(range = 261:312, k = 1.04, h = 2.26)
cusum <- algo.cusum(disProgObj, control = control)
cusum_up <- cusum$upperbound

weeks_2024 <- weekly_cases %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  mutate(
    farrington_ub = f_up,
    cusum_ub = cusum_up
  )

weekly_cases <- weekly_cases %>%
  left_join(
    weeks_2024 %>% select(year, week, farrington_ub, cusum_ub),
    by = c("year", "week")
  )

## Serfling algorithms
weekly_cases <- weekly_cases %>% 
  mutate(t = row_number())

train <- filter(weekly_cases, year != 2024)

sm <- lm(cases ~ t + sin(2*pi*t/52) + cos(2*pi*t/52), data = train)

predict <- predict(sm, newdata = weekly_cases, interval = "predict")

weekly_cases$serfling <- predict[,3]
```

```{r}
plot_data_long <- weekly_cases %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  select(week, cases, cdc, farrington_ub, cusum_ub, serfling) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cdc, farrington_ub, cusum_ub, serfling),
    names_to = "algorithm", values_to = "threshold"
  )

algo_labels <- c(
  "cdc" = "CDC",
  "farrington_ub" = "Farrington",
  "cusum_ub" = "CUSUM",
  "serfling" = "Serfling"
)

colors <- c(
  "CDC" = "#e31a1c",
  "Farrington" = "black",
  "CUSUM" = "#ff7f00",
  "Serfling" = "darkgreen"
)

plot_data_long <- plot_data_long %>%
  mutate(algorithm_label = recode(algorithm, !!!algo_labels))

algos <- unique(plot_data_long$algorithm_label)

# plotly
p <- plot_ly()

# --- Add cột cases có viền đen ---
p <- p %>% add_bars(
  data = filter(plot_data_long, algorithm_label == "CDC"),
  x = ~week, y = ~cases, name = "Cases",
  marker = list(color = '#1696d2', line = list(color = "black", width = 1)),
  hoverinfo = 'text',
  text = ~paste("Week:", week, "<br>Cases:", cases)
)

# --- Add từng line của ngưỡng theo thuật toán ---
for (algo in algos) {
  p <- p %>% add_lines(
    data = filter(plot_data_long, algorithm_label == algo),
    x = ~week, y = ~threshold,
    name = algo,
    line = list(color = colors[[algo]], width = 2),
    visible = ifelse(algo == "CDC", TRUE, FALSE)
  )
}

# Layout
p <- p %>% layout(
  title = list(
    text = "Trends 2024",
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#1696d2")
  ),
  xaxis = list(
    title = list(
    text = "<b>Report Weeks<b>",
    font = list(size = 13, family = "Arial", color = "black", bold = TRUE)
  ),
    tickmode = "array",
    tickvals = seq(1, 52, by = 4),
    ticktext = seq(1, 52, by = 4),
    tickfont = list(size = 11, color = "black"),
    gridcolor = "#d3d3d3",
    zeroline = TRUE,          
    zerolinecolor = "black",
    zerolinewidth = 1
  ),
  yaxis = list(
    title = list(
    text = "<b>Number of Cases<b>",
    font = list(size = 13, family = "Arial", color = "black", bold = TRUE)
  ),
    tickfont = list(size = 11, color = "black"),
    gridcolor = "#d3d3d3",
    zeroline = TRUE,           
    zerolinecolor = "black",
    zerolinewidth = 1
  ),
  legend = list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5,
    y = -0.2,
    xanchor = "center",
    title = list(text = "")
  ),
  plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
  paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      type = "dropdown",
      x = 1.15, y = 1,
      buttons = lapply(algos, function(algo) {
        list(
          method = "update",
          label = algo,
          args = list(
            list(visible = c(TRUE, algos == algo)),
            list(title = paste("Trends 2024 -", algo))
          )
        )
      })
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
p
```
